essentials.title: Flights
essentials.text: Out, British Airways: BA0186 Austin (AUS) Monday September 21 at 10:30 PM to Heathrow (LHR) Terminal 5, lands 1:55 PM September 22, Club World. Connect at Terminal 5, about 5 hours. BA0522 Heathrow 7:05 PM to Florence Peretola (FLR), lands 10:20 PM, Club Europe. Two checked bags at 32 kg each on both legs. Arno Travel's transfer meets you outside baggage claim with an ECCELLENZE sign and takes you to Borgo Pignano Florence. Home: United KYMT99 was cancelled September 19 and refunded in full. The return on October 16 is rebooked on points, details to follow.

essentials.title: Rental car
essentials.text: Avis #26405920US2. Fiat 600, automatic, unlimited km. Pick up Florence Vespucci (FLR) Friday September 25, booked for 9:00 AM, move to 12:00. Drop Rome Fiumicino (FCO) Saturday October 10, booked for 12:00 PM, move to about 2:00 PM. $1,358.61 prepaid. No car from October 10 onward; Arno Travel asked to help with transfers for the Amalfi leg.

essentials.title: Why this trip
essentials.text: Italy collection for Suites With Keith / Fora, releasing print and digital February / March 2027. Eccellenze hosts the first two Florence nights. Everything after is site inspections, shoots and hosted or paid stays.

essentials.title: Drive times
essentials.text: Tuscany to Portofino about 3 hours. Portofino to Cernobbio about 2 hours 45. Como to the Dolomites about 3 hours. Alpe di Siusi to Montalcino about 4 hours 30, the longest day. Val d'Orcia to Rome about 2 hours 30. Rome to Positano about 3 hours.

essentials.title: Pace
essentials.text: This is a sketch, not a schedule. Slow mornings, gym and breakfast, no hotel departures before 11:00. One property visit a day is the target, two is the ceiling, and where you are staying counts as seen. Times on the page are suggestions to steer replies toward, not commitments. If a day feels full, drop the second stop.

blocks.name: Amalfi Coast
blocks.summary: Arrive by train and private boat, not the coast road: Rome to Naples by Frecciarossa, Sunrise Sorrento from the port to Le Sirenuse on the 13th. On the 14th a hotel hop by water, San Pietro's dock, Treville, then Santa Caterina for two hosted nights. Depart Naples on the 16th.
blocks.drive: Rome to Positano about 3 hours. No car from October 10, Arno Travel asked to help with transfers for this leg.

days.label: Rome to Positano by train and boat

stay.name: Le Sirenuse, Positano
stay.detail: Confirmed September 22 at 600 euros, an industry rate extended personally by Antonio Sersale after Leeann Pisacane's note. Kept over a hosted night at Treville: iconic, and you wanted to sleep there. Sersale family, Franco's Bar, La Sponda.

items.title: Hotel de Russie, site visit proposed
items.detail: Andrea Ercoli offered a Rome visit, reply drafted for the 13th at 11:00.

items.title: Frecciarossa Rome Termini to Napoli Centrale
items.detail: About 1 hour 10. Book a seat once the de Russie time is fixed.
items.todo: Book the Rome to Naples train for about 12:30 on the 13th.

items.title: Car to the port, private boat to Positano
items.detail: Asked Sunrise Sorrento September 22 for a private boat from Naples to Positano, arriving about 3:30 at Le Sirenuse, a swing past Capri if realistic. This is the content angle: the private boat transfer is what turned Greece posts into clients. Waiting on Teresa's pricing.

items.title: Arrive Le Sirenuse by sea
items.detail: Porters from the pier. Check in, the terrace, Franco's Bar.

days.label: Hotel hop by boat, then Santa Caterina

stay.name: Hotel Santa Caterina, Amalfi
stay.detail: First of two nights, October 14 to 16, booking #578698902, double room single occupancy, complimentary B&B. Confirmed September 21 by Chiara at the hotel after Valeria D'Amato's offer on behalf of Andrew Camera (Hotel Manager). Nut allergy noted with the kitchen. Site inspection of the hotel and Casa Marchesa during the stay, time to be set on property. You placed the Meckleys and Goffs here.

items.title: Boat from the Positano pier
items.detail: Second Sunrise day asked: Positano, San Pietro's dock, Treville, then Amalfi. Bags by road or on board.

items.title: Il San Pietro di Positano, site visit
items.detail: Agostino Piccolo, September 16: a pleasure, let him know the date and time. You have not sent the time. Arrive at their dock.
items.todo: Confirm 11:00 AM on the 14th with Agostino, arriving by boat.

items.title: Villa Treville, site visit
items.detail: Daniela offered to host the 13th, you kept Sirenuse. Visit at 12:30 proposed in the drafted reply.

items.title: By boat east to Amalfi, check in at Santa Caterina
items.detail: The hotel has a lift down to its sea platform.

stay.name: Hotel Santa Caterina, Amalfi

Confirmed September 21 by Chiara at the hotel after Valeria D'Amato's offer on behalf of Andrew Camera (Hotel Manager). Nut allergy noted with the kitchen. Site inspection of the hotel and Casa Marchesa during the stay, time to be set on property. You placed the Meckleys and Goffs here.

items.title: Santa Caterina and Casa Marchesa, site inspection on the spot
Borgo Santandrea, site visit
items.detail: Antonella Gatto asked September 14 to host, no reply. Now a visit ask, 15 minutes west in Conca dei Marini.

items.title: Caruso (Belmond), Ravello

items.title: Palazzo Avino, Ravello

items.title: Transfer to Naples airport (NAP)
items.detail: Amalfi to Naples airport is about 1 hour 30 without traffic. Timing follows the award flight once the confirmation is in. Arno asked to help.

items.title: Return flight, booked on points, details to come
items.detail: United KYMT99 was cancelled September 19 and refunded in full, $2,260.23, on September 21. The replacement is booked on points. Send the confirmation and the times go here.
items.todo: Send the award booking confirmation for the return on the 16th.
